description: Presidential Secretariat - Sri Lanka Air Force Promotion, Retirement and Appointment.
categorisation: This gazette contains ONLY government personnel changes (promotions, retirement, and appointments) with named individuals (Air Chief Marshal Rajapaksa Appuhamillage Udeni Priyadarshana Rajapaksa and Air Vice Marshal Vasu Bandu Edirisinghe) and their basic titles/ranks, but NO detailed portfolio responsibilities or descriptions of what they are responsible for in terms of subject areas.
